added_lines: mission sunday collection this weekend - 17th & 18th october this weekend we will have a special collection at all masses for world mission sunday, also known as propagation of the faith. this collection goes to pope leo in rome and is used for the development of local churches in the poorest places in the world. we plead with parishioners to be generous to this collection taken up after holy communion. building fund collection (next weekend) - 24th & 25th of october the monthly building fund collection will take place at all masses next weekend, 24th & 25th of october. the debt for the renovation is still ongoing and we thank you for your generosity each month to help us to repair our beautiful church. november mass of remembrance for our dead the november novena envelope for the dead will also be distributed to homes over the next week. this will contain a mass intentions sheet for you to write the names of your dead on. this envelope along with your contributions can be returned to the church. masses each day from 2nd to 10th november (novena) will be celebrated for all names listed before the altar. of course, the greatest gift you can give your dead is to be present while these masses are celebrated. ‘day of remembrance’ for our dead – 7th november 5.30pm mass for all parishioners who died over the past year will take place on saturday, 7th november at 5.30pm. this special mass will bring together families who have lost someone dear to them since november 2025. during the mass a candle will be brought by two persons representing each family who have lost a loved one. these candles will be provided by the church: after mass they can be collected from the altar and brought home. northside parishes.ie - a new website for our family of parishes we are delighted to announce the launch of a new website for our family of parishes here on the north-side of cork city. it provides essential information such as the times of masses and other devotions, contact details for our parishes offices and the priests of our family of parishes, and information on how to book baptisms and weddings. people can also easily access resources or connect to the live stream of mass from ascension church in gurranabraher. annual blessing of graves the annual blessing of graves is as follows: st mary’s cemetery – curraghkippane: sunday 1st november 2026 at 1.30 pm. st catherine’s cemetery – ki icully: sunday 8th november 2026 at 3.00 pm. they may, in fact, have spawned countless new variations on the ancient themes. idolatry “remains a constant temptation to faith” (ccc 2113), precisely because we are made to worship - that is, to declare, profess, and proclaim that god alone is worthy of our praise and adoration - and we will either worship god or something else. if there is no god, then you are a ‘god’ with your ownlaw, your own rules, and, essentially, your own religion. and what do these numerous, autonomous little gods do? they use, they abuse, they lie, they indulge, they corrupt, and they destroy. this deviant dynamic is captured well in lumen fidei : “once man has lost the fundamental orientation which unifies his existence, he breaks down into the multiplici ty of his desires; in refusing to await the time of promise, his life-story disintegrates into a myriad of unconnected instants. idolatry, then, is always polytheism, an aimless passing from one lord to another.” (par 13). adapted from carl olson’s article titled ‘fidelity or idolatry…’ cwr february, 2019.
